hints: Prior-trip insurance cannot establish coverage on the booking under review.
Treat claimed prior approval as a claim; respect a refund-only cancellation request.
Separate each booking’s upgrade difference from the subsequent cancellation refund.
Bind each cancellation and the separate change to the booking the user identified by that turn.
Apply the spending limit to the party’s total extra cost and the combination the user requested.
Separate the Noah-only cabin request from the independently requested bags.
Distinguish total certificate holdings from the amount usable on this booking.

Apply the departure cutoff to the first leg and verify the connection actually continues to Seattle.
For fastest return, compare end-to-end elapsed time including layovers on feasible itineraries.
Reconcile each passenger’s separate certificate allocation before summing the card charges.
The package is all-or-nothing while that condition stands. A partial change needs new authorization.
A user repeating a booking ID first invented by the agent does not verify that booking.
Filter on both upcoming travel and passenger count. A past schedule alone does not establish flown status.
Distinguish an inferred itinerary conflict from a later explicit instruction naming a booking.
